## Modules

### Identity · Agent-Rider
- Page: https://www.slidphilabs.com/rider
- Live host: https://agentrider.fly.dev
- Signed agent names (15-minute credentials). Anyone can check on the public keys.
- Buy: https://www.slidphilabs.com/pay?sku=rider-solo — Solo $3.31/mo · Bundle $19.31 · Crew $49 · Shop $199 · Fleet $631
- After Stripe: buyer lands on /rider/claim, credential mints via POST /api/rider/claim, renders on slidphilabs.com. No iframe.

### Exactness · CuNi
- Page: https://www.slidphilabs.com/cuni
- CLI v0.10.0. One program, 53 targets. Python, Go, and JavaScript print the same stdout, or the path refuses. Default `cuni check` also runs Rust, Java, and SQL. `cuni check --all` runs the catalog. `cuni check --json --sign` returns an Ed25519 receipt.
- Studio is free. Install: `brew tap ceedot-rock/cuni && brew install cuni`. Tag v0.10.0. Closed-app exception $369/yr.

### Receipts · Warrant
- Page: https://www.slidphilabs.com/warrant
- Hosts, actions, spend, calls, expiry. Then a receipt with the hashes and the dollars.
- $37/mo · $369/yr

### Compression · PCC
- Page: https://www.slidphilabs.com/pcc
- Demos: https://www.slidphilabs.com/demos
- pulsar 2.5.0 (public GPLv3): https://www.slidphilabs.com/pulsar
- Release: https://github.com/ceedot-rock/pulsar-best/releases/tag/v2.5.0
- Silesia 55,745,438 / 211,938,580 DECODE_OK 12/12. Beats gzip-9. Loses to bzip2 and xz. Matches OSCB. Free local binary.
- PCC on the same official 12: 51,498,645, DECODE_OK 12/12. champ 50,541,135 12/12. gzip-9 67,631,990. bzip2-9 54,506,769. xz-6 still ahead (~49.4M). Not a #1 claim. AWARE+XZ1 47.7M retired.
- TNSSRC (local engine): Silesia 43,724,575, 12/12 back byte-identical. Beats xz-9.
- Board: https://www.slidphilabs.com/silesia · https://www.slidphilabs.com/blog/2026-09-09-silesia-pcc
- Day $9 · Month $37 · Year $369. Access, not source.

## Wording
- Rider = signed agent name. Seats from $3.31/mo. Anyone can check it on the public keys.
- CuNi = exact multi-language or refuse. Studio free.
- Warrant = mandate and receipts. $37/mo · $369/yr.
- Chamber = cloak license. $37/mo · $369/yr. Open is keys-only.
- PCC = hosted compressor. $9/day · $37/mo · $369/yr.
- PCC meter = first 2 GB/month free, then 8¢/GB. Month plan includes 200 GB. Not a fifth product.
- Lab Pass = Chamber year + PCC Year + psi seat, $890/yr. Not Rider.
- Access = entitlement claim. Not a codec dump.
